transcript.text: Sir, here's what we found this morning. The six unserviceable battery packs have swollen casings, and that condition is covered by a manufacturer safety bulletin. Because of that, they must be quarantined rather than repaired. I've scheduled property-office pickup for Wednesday at 1000. One note: the inspection sheet is still in the shop binder and has not yet been entered in the maintenance control log, so that will need to be recorded.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Sir, here's the current technical status for the rugged tablets. IT Support completed certified data erasure on all eight rugged tablets and found them serviceable for the training cell. They must be reissued to the training cell with an asset transfer scheduled for Friday at 0900. One note: the data erasure certificates are filed in the IT ticket system but have not yet been attached to the reconciliation packet, so that will need to be included before the order is signed.
transcript.speaker: A3
